sources.label: M0 platform mechanics and eligible collateral

reserveReview.rationale: M0 documents an eligible-collateral policy, while its official collateral-composition recipe exposes cash, Treasury, and on-chain token-collateral aggregates, including eligible and non-eligible subcategories. Those sources do not support a static 100% Treasury-bill claim or a durable current split, so the authored fallback remains one unresolved aggregate while the configured M0 adapter supplies live composition.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: M0 collateral policy and official collateral-composition API field model
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Current cash, Treasury, token, eligibility, maturity, token-identity, and minter-level weights are not pinned in this static review.
